format.Listening: 40 questions, 30 minutes + 10 min transfer time (paper) or no transfer time (computer)
format.Writing: 2 tasks — Task 1: 150 words (describe data/process), Task 2: 250 words (essay), 60 minutes total
format.Speaking: 11-14 minutes, face-to-face interview with examiner (3 parts: intro, long turn, discussion)

ielts.scoring: 0-9 band scale (half bands possible, e.g. 6.5). Each section scored separately. Overall = average of 4 sections, rounded to nearest half band.
ielts.cost: $255 USD (approximately GHS 3,800 in Ghana — varies by test center and exchange rate)
ielts.test_centers_ghana: British Council Accra, IDP IELTS Accra. Computer-delivered and paper-based both available.
ielts.one_skill_retake: NEW: If you're close to your target score, you can retake just ONE section (Listening, Reading, Writing, or Speaking) instead of the full test. Available at select centers.

toefl.full_name: Test of English as a Foreign Language (iBT)
types: TOEFL iBT (primary test — MAJOR UPDATE January 2026)
TOEFL iBT Home Edition (take from home)
toefl.important_update: ⚠️ MAJOR CHANGE: As of January 2026, TOEFL iBT uses a new 1-6 band scale (similar to IELTS) instead of the old 0-120 scale. During the 2-year transition period (until Jan 2028), you'll also receive a comparable 0-120 score. The test format has been completely redesigned with new task types.

format.Reading: 50 items, ~30 minutes (Complete the Words, Read in Daily Life, Read an Academic Passage)
format.Listening: 47 items, ~29 minutes (Listen and Choose, Conversations, Announcements, Academic Talks)
format.Writing: 12 items, ~23 minutes (Build a Sentence, Write an Email, Academic Discussion)
format.Speaking: 11 items, ~8 minutes (Listen and Repeat, Take an Interview)

toefl.scoring: NEW: 1-6 band scale per section. Overall = average of 4 sections, rounded to nearest 0.5. During transition (until Jan 2028), you'll also get 0-120 comparable score.

common_requirements.Note: Universities are transitioning to the new scale. Check each university for updated requirements.

toefl.cost: $200-245 USD (varies by country — check ETS website for Ghana-specific pricing)
toefl.test_centers_ghana: ETS-authorized centers in Accra. TOEFL iBT Home Edition also available (take from home with webcam).

gmat.full_name: Graduate Management Admission Test (GMAT Focus Edition)
types: GMAT Focus Edition (new format since November 2023, replaces old GMAT)

format.Quantitative Reasoning: 21 questions, 45 minutes (problem solving, no data sufficiency)
format.Verbal Reasoning: 23 questions, 45 minutes (critical reasoning, reading comprehension — no sentence correction)
format.Data Insights: 20 questions, 45 minutes (data sufficiency, multi-source reasoning, graphics/table interpretation, two-part analysis)

gmat.scoring: Total: 205-805 (in 10-point increments). Each section: 60-90. No separate AWA score.
gmat.cost: $275 USD (online) / $300 USD (test center). Includes sending scores to 5 programs free.
gmat.test_centers_ghana: Pearson VUE test centers in Accra. GMAT Online (at home) also available.
